scope: Read-only review of phone web visibility identity and modal-preservation paths

findings.finding: Recovery export outside checkingIdentity guard could read/download old account data during failed/pending identity checks or after lock during await.
findings.recommendedFix: Gate recovery actions on confirmed identity; capture and recheck generation/scope before download.
findings.status: Reported to root; implementation owned by root.

findings.finding: hidden={checkingIdentity} preserves mounted editor data, but unguarded X/Escape allowed privacy-curtain dismissal to silently unmount dirty record/add forms.
findings.recommendedFix: Do not dismiss the curtain while checking identity; make any dirty-form discard explicit.
findings.status: Reported; subsequent read shows root now disables X/Escape while checkingIdentity.

findings.finding: An older initial GET could overwrite a workspace confirmed by the independent visibility check when the account is unchanged but workspace was recreated.
findings.recommendedFix: Use one identity generation/ticket or compare already-confirmed workspaceRef before accepting the initial response.

positiveFindings: Modal content uses a hidden wrapper instead of unmounting children on a transient identity check, preserving controlled and uncontrolled form state.
No current CSS rule inspected overrides display on the hidden wrapper.
Workspace accountId checks and request generation guards prevent a completed different-account response from silently replacing the original private scope.
runtimeValidation: Source analysis only; production browser acceptance is owned by root.
